children: Jersey Mike’s reported fiscal second-quarter results for the period ended June 28, 2026, with total revenue of $208 million and Adjusted EBITDA of $114 million. Systemwide sales rose 10% year-over-year to $1.210 billion while net income was $37 million for the quarter. The company opened 83 new stores, drove net unit growth of 8.1%, and raised digital sales mix to 43%.
Total revenue: $208 million for the quarter (up 10% year over year).
Systemwide sales: $1.210 billion for the quarter (up 10% year over year).
Net income: $37 million for the quarter (versus $59 million in prior year).
Adjusted EBITDA: $114 million for the quarter (versus $107 million in prior year).
Same-store sales increased 2.3%, driven primarily by transaction growth.
Opened 83 new stores in the quarter, resulting in net store growth of 8.1% year over year and a total of 3,378 stores systemwide as of June 28, 2026.
Digital channels continued to expand, with digital sales representing 43% of systemwide sales (up from 41% year over year).
Average unit volume (AUV) for the comparable store base was $1.376 million (trailing 364 days basis).

Management provided full-year fiscal 2026 outlook: same-store sales growth of 2.5–3.0% (including 3.0–4.0% in Q3), net unit growth of at least 8%, and Adjusted EBITDA growth of at least 20% for the year.
